title: Integral proper direct image on the localizing categories
statement:
Work in the standing scheme setting [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]: fix a prime $\ell$, a field $k$ of characteristic $p>0$ different from $\ell$, and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\pi_E$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $X,Y$ be separated finite-type $k$-schemes and $p:X\to Y$ a proper $k$-morphism, with geometric fibres of Krull dimension at most $d\in\mathbf Z_{\ge0}$ [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-pc-scheme-fibre, def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. Use the condensed ring $\underline{\mathcal O_E}$, its pulled-back coefficient sheaves $\mathcal O_{E,T}$ and module objects [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring, sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients, sk-def-sfb-module-objects], and the ordinary unbounded derived categories $D(T_{\mathrm{proét}},\mathcal O_E)=D(\Mod_{\mathcal O_{E,T}})$, for $T=X,Y$ [sk-def-sfb-derived-categories]. Let $Rp_*$ be the total right derived module-object pushforward [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull]. Write $\Cons(T,\mathcal O_E)$ for constructible coefficient-module sheaves and $\Dbc(T,\mathcal O_E)$ for bounded complexes with constructible cohomology [sk-def-sfb-constructible]. Define $\IndCons(T,\mathcal O_E)$ to consist of sheaves isomorphic to small filtered colimits of objects of $\Cons(T,\mathcal O_E)$, computed in the ambient module category; put $\Dic(T,\mathcal O_E)=\{K:H^i(K)\in\IndCons(T,\mathcal O_E)\text{ for all }i\}$ as in [det-prop-int-compactness-compact]. Let $\Loc(\Dbc(T,\mathcal O_E))$ be the smallest full replete triangulated subcategory containing $\Dbc$ and closed under ordinary small coproducts in this ambient derived category [det-def-localizing-closure-existence]. All sums and filtered diagrams are small in the fixed universe [def-weil-size-convention]. Then:

1. For $N\in\Cons(X,\mathcal O_E)$, $Rp_*N\in\Dbc(Y,\mathcal O_E)$ has cohomology in degrees $[0,2d+1]$. For $N\in\IndCons(X,\mathcal O_E)$, $H^qRp_*N\in\IndCons(Y,\mathcal O_E)$ and vanishes outside $[0,2d+1]$.
2. For $K\in\Dic(X,\mathcal O_E)$ and $q\in\mathbf Z$, the canonical truncation zig-zag $K\leftarrow\tau_{\le q}K\to\tau_{\ge q-2d-1}\tau_{\le q}K$ [def-kun-truncations] induces isomorphisms on $H^qRp_*$. The functor $Rp_*$ commutes with arbitrary direct sums of objects of $\Dic(X,\mathcal O_E)$.
3. $Rp_*$ maps $\Loc(\Dbc(X,\mathcal O_E))$ into $\Loc(\Dbc(Y,\mathcal O_E))$ and preserves direct sums there.

external.place: Direct image commutes with derived limits, so $Rp_*N=R\varprojlim_nRp_*(N\otimes^{\mathbf L}\mathcal O_E/\pi_E^n)$ by derived completeness of $N$, and one derived limit of a countable tower raises the upper bound by at most one (Milnor sequence): $Rp_*N$ has cohomology in degrees $\le2d+1$.

The proofs of [sk-lem-proper-unbounded-window] and [sk-lem-proper-unbounded-window-ii], which use only this uniform bound, the left completeness of the pro-étale derived category and the Milnor sequence, show that $H^qRp_*K=H^qRp_*\tau_{[q-2d-1,q]}K$.

proof.text: Obtain the two heart upper estimates, preservation of Dbc and the bounded-above amplitude from integral proper cohomological bounds. Obtain truncation/sum stability of Dic and Loc(Dbc) contained in Dic from integral ind-derived stability. Lower bounds follow from rightDerivedFunctorPlus compatibility, using a derived-plus object with the same underlying object.

Map the upper truncation triangle at q by F. Lower-bound preservation kills the last image in degrees q-1 and q. The homology long exact sequence makes H^q of F(tau_le(q)K -> K) invertible. In the lower triangle at q-2d-1 the bounded-above amplitude makes the discarded tail at most q-1. Mono and epi criteria in the long exact sequence give the second actual arrow as an isomorphism.

For each q it suffices for sums to truncate only below q-2d-1: that arrow is an H^qF-isomorphism for each summand and the sum. Lower good truncation preserves sums by its reflection universal property, since cohomology preserves sums and the nonnegative aisle is sum closed. Qcqs bounded-below coproduct continuity applies to the truncated family. Naturality of the truncation arrows gives the canonical comparison square. Three sides are isomorphisms, hence so is the fourth. Cohomology detects isomorphisms, yielding the actual mapped colimit cofan. This replaces the finite-interval induction by the already available stronger common-lower-bound theorem.

The intersection of Loc(B_X) with the inverse image of Loc(B_Y) is replete and triangulated. On an existing larger coproduct shrink its nonzero support, which injects into the small endomorphism set of its vertex. The proved relative small-sum preservation then implies sum closure in the object universe. The intersection contains B_X by proper preservation. Minimality of Loc proves its image belongs to Loc(B_Y); containment in Dic gives coproduct preservation there.

proof_origin.place: F5 formalization of proof (1)-(3): real triangle, comparison-square and localizing-minimality glue, with geometric estimates and the abelian Ind-closure step isolated. Uses the existing stronger bounded-below coproduct theorem in place of finite-range induction.

Second reading made the local-completeness to reduction-tower comparison explicit using the existing one-generator Koszul reflector and strict-tower Roos triangle. Item statement: it matches the blueprint with the standing setting made explicit. The coefficient category is the ordinary D(Mod_{O_E,X}), the same as det-prop-int-compactness-compact and det-thm-sfb-proper-base-change-integral. Cons/Dbc use the finite-constant-local-model predicate of sk-def-sfb-constructible, which is the same predicate the adic criterion uses. The bound 2d+1 is unchanged, and the two actual truncation arrows make 'depends only on [q-2d-1,q]' precise. Stacks sources checked at the cited places: 095U etale-cohomology.tex lemma-cohomological-dimension-proper; 08TB/08TC/07KC/0H72 in derived.tex; tags 099B and 0A0E. 099Q is indeed proetale-proposition-enough-weakly-contractibles, so the worker was right to drop it as a completeness pointer. The completeness notion of the adic criterion (def-weil-pbc-locally-derived-ringed-ideal-complete) is exactly the local condition of the Koszul reflector, so step 2 holds. Step 3: the cone-lifting induction through the fully faithful exact nu^* is correct. Step 4: H^{-1}[1] gives degrees up to 2d-1, and qcqs comparison plus ringed-topos composition with exact restriction is correct. Steps 6-11 check out: continuity into p_*A-modules followed by restriction along eta_p; the window arrows kill degrees q-1,q and q,q+1; finite-range induction with summed triangles and the five lemma; arbitrary sums through the common window; the localizing closure by minimality. New node lem-sfb-left-complete-heart-upper-bound: I proved it independently and it is true. The finite induction gives b+c, Roos plus exact products gives b+c+1, and the transition triangle with T-image <= c-n-1 makes H^{b+c} eventually isomorphic. An explicit finite-sum section of 1-s then kills lim^1 in any abelian category with exact products. Tested T=id, T=0, T=[r] (c=-r), K=0, a single degree, an infinite negative tail, and S without 0. Replacing the rational window lemmas' proofs, which are outside unit uses, with a coefficient-free lemma is a correct realization, not a route departure, and no SGA is used.
